row.description: Clinical laboratory reference interval convention for fasting plasma glucose, reported as a lower and upper reference boundary in mg/dL.

neighbors.relation: single patient result interpreted against the interval
another laboratory reference interval with a different analyte and unit

row.wrong_generalization: The two numbers are not the minimum and maximum values observed in a dataset; they are a clinically defined reference interval. Treating them as sample extrema changes their meaning.

row.description: HL7 Version 2 field repetition convention: repeated field values are separated by the default repetition separator, tilde (~), as in an OBX or PID field when local content is simple coded text.

neighbors.relation: caret separates components within one field repetition
ampersand separates subcomponents within a component

row.wrong_generalization: Treating tilde-separated content as one opaque value is wrong: in HL7 v2, each tilde begins another repetition. Conversely, a trailing or doubled tilde does not represent a populated coded repetition here.

concept: FDA National Drug Code package-label display

row.concept: FDA National Drug Code package-label display
row.description: FDA National Drug Code (NDC) 10-digit display convention, whose hyphenated labeler-product-package segments can be 4-4-2, 5-3-2, or 5-4-1.

neighbors.relation: zero-padded billing normalization of an NDC
drug terminology identifier rather than a package-label code

row.wrong_generalization: Examples can make NDC labels look fixed-width, especially in 4-4-2 form, but FDA 10-digit display layouts vary by segment. Assuming one hyphen position pattern rejects valid NDCs.
